detail.longDescription: A version check catches only half of the Cursor marketplace attack. Tampered Claude Code 2.1.313 used a number no official host ever carried. Tampered 2.1.312 used a real one, so only hashes or contents expose it. Served about 11 hours on Oct 29, the payload ran on load. Cursor says enabling SSH failed on most hosts, yet uninstalling may leave persistence scripts running. https://www. stepsecurity.io/blog/claude-co de-extension-trojanized # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # DevOps
